literal_meaning: মাথায় রেখে ধারণ করা (keeping on the head)
figurative_meaning_en: to hold in high regard or revere
example_sentences_in_bangla: আদর্শ ছেলেরা বাবা-মাকে মাথায় করে রাখে।
সে তার গুরুকে মাথায় করে রাখে।
example_sentences_in_english: Ideal sons hold their parents in the highest regard.
She reveres her teacher as if keeping them on her head.
note: Reflects traditional Bengali values of filial piety and respect for elders.
